schema_note: sprint_id pattern ^S\d+$ in lld.schema.json applies to V1 sprints only; V2 introduces a major-version identifier. Schema will be updated at /ases-schema V2.
scope_summary: V2 completes the four items deferred from V1 (roadmap.deferred[]). F-013/F-014 (M-008) retrofit authentication and RBAC across all API endpoints using JWT + OAuth2PasswordBearer; three roles: STAFF (data entry), VERIFIER (read-only), SUPERVISOR (full access + user management). F-015 (M-009) adds the Inward Report as a dual-pane Consolidation + Transactions read-only view mirroring the S3 Sales Report pattern. F-016 (M-010) adds PDF and Excel export for both Sales and Inward reports via StreamingResponse. F-017/F-018/F-019 (M-011) introduce a Price Master per (design, grade) and an Invoicing + Payment module built on top of existing S2 sales data. All V1 endpoints acquire auth guards in main.py with zero changes to V1 router files. TD-008 (first-row insert race) verified closed by DS-015 advisory lock — a test TC is added for coverage.

module_definitions.M-008: Authentication & Authorization — JWT-based login, user CRUD, role enforcement across all endpoints
module_definitions.M-009: Inward Report — read-only dual-pane (Consolidation + Transactions) mirroring M-005 Sales Report
module_definitions.M-010: Report Export — PDF and Excel streaming export for Sales and Inward reports
module_definitions.M-011: Pricing & Invoicing — Price Master CRUD, Invoice generation from sales data, Payment recording

files.purpose: SQLAlchemy 2.x ORM model for tbl_user_master. Stores login credentials and role assignment for V2 auth.

functions.name: UserModel
functions.description: __tablename__ = 'tbl_user_master'. Columns: id (Integer PK autoincrement), username (String(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL), password_hash (String(255) NOT NULL), role (Enum('STAFF','VERIFIER','SUPERVISOR') NOT NULL), is_active (Boolean DEFAULT True NOT NULL), created_at (DateTime(timezone=True) server_default=func.now()). Index: ix_user_master_username on username. Inherits TimestampMixin for created_at per DS-014.

files.purpose: UserRepository — thin data-access layer for tbl_user_master. Extends BaseRepository[UserModel].

functions.name: UserRepository.get_by_username
functions.description: SELECT * FROM tbl_user_master WHERE username = :username LIMIT 1. Case-sensitive match. Returns None if not found.

functions.name: UserRepository.list_active
functions.description: SELECT * FROM tbl_user_master WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY username ASC.

files.purpose: Pure domain functions for password hashing and JWT token lifecycle. No I/O, no SQLAlchemy — fully unit-testable in isolation.

functions.name: get_password_hash
functions.description: Returns bcrypt hash of the plain password via passlib.context.CryptContext(schemes=['bcrypt']).

functions.name: verify_password
functions.description: Returns True if plain_password matches hashed_password via CryptContext.verify(). Constant-time comparison.

functions.name: create_access_token
functions.description: Creates a signed JWT with sub=username, role=role, exp=now+expires_delta (default 8h per DS-018). Signed with SECRET_KEY from config using HS256. Uses python-jose.

functions.name: decode_access_token
functions.description: Decodes and validates a JWT. Returns the payload dict on success; returns None on expired or malformed token. Never raises — callers check None and raise HTTPException 401.

files.purpose: Auth business logic: login verification, user creation, listing, fetch-by-id, partial update, and canonical soft-deactivation. Delegates DB access to UserRepository and password ops to domain.auth.

functions.name: AuthService.authenticate
functions.description: Looks up user by username; raises HTTPException 401 if not found or is_active=false. Verifies password via verify_password; raises 401 on mismatch. Returns TokenResponse with access_token, token_type='bearer', role.

functions.name: AuthService.get_current_user
functions.description: Decodes JWT via decode_access_token; raises HTTPException 401 if None. Fetches user from DB by payload['sub']; raises 401 if not found or is_active=false.

functions.name: AuthService.create_user
functions.description: Checks username uniqueness via get_by_username; raises HTTPException 409 on conflict. Hashes password via get_password_hash. Persists via UserRepository.create(). Returns created UserModel.

functions.name: AuthService.list_users
functions.description: Returns UserRepository.list_active() — active users only, ordered by username.

functions.name: AuthService.update_user
functions.description: Fetches user by id; raises HTTPException 404 if not found. Applies is_active and/or role updates. If new_password provided, rehashes via get_password_hash. Returns updated UserModel.

functions.name: AuthService.get_user
functions.description: Read-only fetch by id via UserRepository.get(user_id). No commit — HTTP-safe per RFC 9110 §9.2.1. Raises HTTPException 404 (NotFoundError bubbles through global handler) if user is absent.

functions.name: AuthService.deactivate_user
functions.description: Canonical soft-delete per DS-008. Calls UserRepository.soft_delete(user_id) (sets is_active=False via BaseRepository primitive) then commits. Raises HTTPException 404 if user_id is unknown.

files.purpose: Alembic migration for all 5 V2 tables. ORM-first per DS-009: generated from Base.metadata targeting only V2 model additions.

functions.name: upgrade
functions.description: CREATE TABLE tbl_user_master (id SERIAL PK, username VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL, password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('STAFF','VERIFIER','SUPERVISOR')), is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE INDEX ix_user_master_username ON tbl_user_master(username). CREATE TABLE tbl_price_master (id SERIAL PK, design_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES tbl_trading_design_master(id), grade_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES tbl_grade_master(id), unit_price NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price >= 0), effective_from DATE NOT NULL, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE UNIQUE CONSTRAINT uq_price_design_grade_effective ON tbl_price_master(design_id, grade_id, effective_from). CREATE TABLE tbl_invoice_header (id SERIAL PK, invoice_number VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE NOT NULL, sales_header_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES tbl_sales_header(id), invoice_date DATE NOT NULL, total_amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK(status IN ('PENDING','PARTIAL','PAID')), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()). CREATE TABLE tbl_invoice_line (id SERIAL PK, invoice_header_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES tbl_invoice_header(id), sales_line_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES tbl_sales_line(id), design_id INT NOT NULL, grade_id INT NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL, unit_price NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL, line_total NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()). CREATE TABLE tbl_payment (id SERIAL PK, invoice_header_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES tbl_invoice_header(id), payment_date DATE NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0), notes TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()).

functions.name: downgrade
functions.description: DROP TABLE tbl_payment; DROP TABLE tbl_invoice_line; DROP TABLE tbl_invoice_header; DROP TABLE tbl_price_master; DROP TABLE tbl_user_master.

files.purpose: Pydantic v2 schemas for the Inward Report dual-payload response: Consolidation (grouped by design+grade) + Transactions (per inward line).

functions.name: InwardConsolidationRow
functions.description: Fields: design_id (int), design_name (str), size (str), grade_id (int), grade_code (str), total_nos (int). Mirrors ConsolidationRow from sales_report.py. ORDER BY design_name ASC, grade_code ASC.

functions.name: InwardTransactionRow
functions.description: Fields: purchase_date (date), supplier_id (int), supplier_name (str), place (str — denormalized snapshot per DS-013), design_id (int), design_name (str), size (str), grade_id (int), grade_code (str), nos (int). ORDER BY purchase_date ASC.

functions.name: InwardReportResponse
functions.description: Fields: consolidation (list[InwardConsolidationRow]), transactions (list[InwardTransactionRow]). Reconciliation invariant: sum(transactions.nos) == sum(consolidation.total_nos) — asserted in InwardReportService before return.

files.purpose: M-009 use case. Dual-payload inward report with multi-select optional filters (date range, supplier, place, design). Mirrors SalesReportService pattern (DS-017: shared filter predicate guarantees reconciliation invariant).

functions.name: InwardReportService.generate
functions.description: (1) Build shared filter predicate list from optional params: purchase_date >= date_from, purchase_date <= date_to, supplier_id IN supplier_ids, tbl_inward_header.place IN places, design_id IN design_ids. No filter = full dataset (RULE-018 mirror). (2) Consolidation query: SELECT design_id, design_name, size, grade_id, grade_code, SUM(nos) FROM tbl_inward_line JOIN tbl_inward_header JOIN tbl_trading_design_master JOIN tbl_grade_master JOIN tbl_supplier_master WHERE <predicates> GROUP BY design_id, grade_id, design_name, size, grade_code ORDER BY design_name, grade_code. (3) Transactions query: SELECT purchase_date, supplier_id, supplier_name, place, design_id, design_name, size, grade_id, grade_code, nos FROM <same joins + predicates> ORDER BY purchase_date ASC, inward_header_id ASC. (4) Assert sum(t.nos) == sum(c.total_nos) before return (defense-in-depth per DS-017). Return InwardReportResponse.
raises: AssertionError (internal — signals a filter predicate divergence bug, should never trigger)

files.purpose: GET /reports/inward route. Multi-select supplier filter mirrors Sales Report's dealer filter. Auth guard applied globally in main.py.

functions.name: get_inward_report
functions.description: GET /reports/inward. Pure delegation: return service.generate(date_from, date_to, supplier_ids, places, design_ids). 200 on success (empty lists valid when no data matches filter).

(2) Filter summary row (date range, dealers, designs etc — 'All' when not filtered). (3) Section header 'Consolidation'. (4) Table: Design | Size | Grade | Total Nos — one row per consolidation entry. (5) Section header 'Transactions'. (6) Table: Date | Supplier | Place | Design | Size | Grade | Nos — one row per transaction. Returns BytesIO seeked to 0.

functions.description: Same layout as export_sales_report but with title 'Inward Report' and transactions columns: Date | Supplier | Place | Design | Size | Grade | Nos.

Row 1 = filter summary merged cell. Row 2 = column headers (bold). Row 3+ = data. Returns BytesIO seeked to 0.

functions.name: PaymentRepository.create

files.purpose: Pure domain functions for invoice arithmetic. No SQLAlchemy, no I/O — fully unit-testable.

functions.name: compute_line_total
functions.description: Returns Decimal(quantity) * unit_price rounded to 2dp via ROUND_HALF_UP. Raises ValueError if quantity <= 0 or unit_price < 0.

functions.name: compute_invoice_total
functions.description: Returns sum(line_totals) rounded to 2dp. Raises ValueError if line_totals is empty.

functions.name: compute_invoice_status
functions.description: paid_sum = sum(paid_amounts). If paid_sum == 0 → 'PENDING'. If paid_sum >= total_amount → 'PAID'. Else → 'PARTIAL'.

functions.name: generate_invoice_number
functions.description: Returns 'INV-{YYYYMMDD}-{sales_header_id:05d}'. Deterministic — same inputs always produce the same number. Uniqueness guaranteed by the UNIQUE constraint on tbl_invoice_header.invoice_number.

files.purpose: M-011 use case for Price Master CRUD. Wraps PriceMasterRepository with business rules: no duplicate active price for same (design, grade, effective_from); unit_price must be >= 0.

functions.name: PricingService.list_prices
functions.description: Returns PriceMasterRepository.list_all() — all rows including inactive, ordered by design, grade, effective_from DESC.

functions.name: PricingService.create_price
functions.description: Validates: design_id exists, grade_id exists, unit_price >= 0. Checks UniqueConstraint via a SELECT before insert to return a clean 409 (rather than catching DB IntegrityError). Inserts and returns PriceMasterModel.
raises: HTTPException 404 design or grade not found

functions.name: PricingService.update_price
functions.description: Fetches by id, applies is_active and/or unit_price updates. Returns updated row. 404 if not found.

files.purpose: M-011 use case for Invoice creation and Payment recording. Fetches sales lines, looks up active prices, builds invoice header + lines in one transaction.

functions.name: InvoiceService.create_from_sales
functions.description: (1) Verify sales_header_id exists; 404 if not. (2) Check no invoice exists for this sales_header_id (FK UNIQUE); 409 if already invoiced. (3) Fetch all sales_line rows for sales_header_id from tbl_sales_line. (4) For each line: get_active_price(design_id, grade_id) — if None, unit_price=0 (price not yet configured; invoice line created with 0 and a warning flag in notes). (5) Compute line_total = compute_line_total(quantity, unit_price). (6) Compute total_amount = compute_invoice_total(line_totals). (7) Generate invoice_number = generate_invoice_number(invoice_date=today, sales_header_id). (8) InvoiceRepository.create_with_lines(header, lines). Returns InvoiceRead.
raises: HTTPException 409 invoice already exists for this sale

functions.name: InvoiceService.list_invoices
functions.description: Delegates to InvoiceRepository.list(). Returns InvoiceSummary projection (header-level only, no lines).

functions.name: InvoiceService.get_invoice
functions.description: Fetches invoice with lines and payments; raises 404 if not found. Returns full InvoiceRead.

functions.name: InvoiceService.record_payment
functions.description: (1) Fetch invoice; 404 if not found. (2) Validate payment amount > 0 and total payments do not exceed invoice total_amount; 422 if overpayment. (3) PaymentRepository.create(invoice_id, data). (4) Recompute status via compute_invoice_status and update tbl_invoice_header.status. (5) Return refreshed InvoiceRead.

expects: TransactionRepository (S2 — to fetch sales_line rows by header)

new_decisions.decision: Authentication uses JWT (JSON Web Tokens) signed with HS256 via python-jose, with an 8-hour access token TTL. Credentials are stored as bcrypt hashes via passlib. No refresh tokens in V2. FastAPI OAuth2PasswordBearer extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header.
new_decisions.rationale: JWT is stateless — no session store required, compatible with the existing single-process uvicorn deployment. 8-hour TTL matches a typical trading day, minimising re-login friction without creating overly long-lived tokens. Bcrypt is the industry standard for password hashing. python-jose + passlib are the canonical FastAPI auth stack with extensive documentation. Refresh tokens add complexity (storage, rotation, revocation) with marginal benefit at single-tenant single-site scale.
new_decisions.tradeoffs: No token revocation in V2 — a deactivated user's existing token remains valid until expiry. Mitigation: get_current_user always re-fetches is_active from the DB on each request, so deactivation takes effect on the next API call. 8-hour TTL bounds the exposure window.
alternatives_considered: Session-based auth (server-side sessions): rejected — requires a session store (Redis or DB table), adds infrastructure dependency.
Short TTL (1h) + refresh tokens: rejected — adds client-side token rotation complexity and a refresh endpoint; overkill for V2 internal-network use.
API key per user: rejected — no per-request expiry, harder to revoke, no standard FastAPI integration.

new_decisions.decision: RBAC uses a single role enum column on tbl_user_master — three roles: STAFF (data entry, read reports), VERIFIER (read only: dashboard + reports), SUPERVISOR (full access including user + price + invoice management). No separate roles or permissions tables.
new_decisions.rationale: Three fixed roles map directly to the PRD user types (Data Entry Staff, Stock Verifier, Management/Supervisor). A roles table with many-to-many user↔role and a permissions table per endpoint would add 3+ tables and a join on every request for a system with exactly 3 roles. The enum column is O(1) to read from the JWT payload (role is included in the token) and from the DB (single column read in get_current_user). Role expansion beyond 3 would warrant a separate permissions table; V2 scope does not require it.
new_decisions.tradeoffs: Role enum is a schema migration if a 4th role is added. Acceptable at V2 scale — migrations are cheap and the ORM change is one field. No fine-grained per-endpoint permission matrix; all SUPERVISOR routes share the same require_supervisor guard.
alternatives_considered: Separate tbl_role + tbl_user_role many-to-many: rejected — 2 extra tables, FK joins, and migration complexity for 3 roles that won't change in V2.
Permission bitfield per user: rejected — opaque, hard to audit, not readable by non-developers.

new_decisions.decision: TD-008 (first-row insert race in tbl_stock_ledger) is CLOSED by DS-015's advisory lock. No code change to domain/stock.py required. V2 adds a new integration test TC covering the concurrent first-row insert scenario to provide explicit regression coverage.
new_decisions.rationale: TD-008 described the race: two concurrent sessions inserting the FIRST-EVER ledger row for the same (design, grade) can both succeed with running_balance=delta. DS-015 (S3 LLD) mandated pg_advisory_xact_lock(design_id, grade_id) BEFORE the FOR UPDATE. This transaction-level advisory lock serializes ALL concurrent writes per (design, grade) pair — including the first-row case, because the second session blocks on the advisory lock until the first session commits. The domain.stock._apply function in backend/src/domain/stock.py already implements this (TD-011 closed in S2). The gap was test coverage — TC-087 (S2) assumed a pre-existing row. V2 explicitly adds a TC for empty-ledger concurrent scenario.
new_decisions.tradeoffs: No code change — test-only addition. Zero risk of regression. The advisory lock was already live in production at V1 ship.
alternatives_considered: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (upsert): considered — would also handle first-row, but changes the ledger's insert-only semantics.
Lock the design_grade_map row as sentinel: rejected by DS-015 (couples admin edits to write path).

new_decisions.decision: Report export uses reportlab for PDF generation and openpyxl for Excel (XLSX) generation. Both produce BytesIO objects returned via FastAPI StreamingResponse.
new_decisions.rationale: reportlab: mature Python PDF library, pure Python, no external binary dependencies (unlike wkhtmltopdf/weasyprint), generates tabular reports via SimpleDocTemplate + Table without HTML intermediary. openpyxl: pure Python XLSX reader/writer, MIT licence, no LibreOffice/Java dependency, well-maintained, produces native .xlsx format that Excel and Google Sheets open without conversion. StreamingResponse avoids buffering large files fully in memory before sending.
new_decisions.tradeoffs: reportlab's API is verbose — building tables requires explicit column widths and styles. Acceptable for 2 report types. openpyxl generates .xlsx only (not .xls); .xlsx has been the default Excel format since 2007 — no concern.
alternatives_considered: weasyprint (HTML→PDF): rejected — requires libpango/libcairo system libraries, complicating the Docker image.
xlsxwriter (Excel): rejected — write-only, no read capability; openpyxl is more broadly useful if read-back is ever needed.
pandas.DataFrame.to_excel: rejected — pulls in the pandas dependency for a use-case that doesn't need DataFrame semantics.

new_decisions.decision: Active price for invoice line population = the tbl_price_master row WHERE design_id=X AND grade_id=G AND is_active=True AND effective_from <= invoice_date ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1. unit_price is snapshotted onto tbl_invoice_line at invoice creation time (immutable after creation). If no active price exists for a (design, grade), unit_price=0 is used and the line carries a warning note.
new_decisions.rationale: Effective-from price lookup gives time-aware pricing: a price change introduced on 2026-08-01 doesn't affect invoices generated before that date. Snapshotting the unit_price on invoice creation (per DS-013 precedent for place denormalisation) gives immutable historical invoices — a price master edit after invoicing never silently retroacts. Zero-price fallback (with warning) prevents invoice creation from blocking when prices are not yet configured, matching the PO's stated workflow where prices may be back-filled.
new_decisions.tradeoffs: If a price is misconfigured, an invoice with unit_price=0 is created silently (with warning note). Admin must notice the warning and re-invoice. Alternative: block invoice creation when price is missing — rejected because it would prevent supervisors from invoicing newly introduced design-grade combinations during a price-configuration catch-up window.
alternatives_considered: Block invoice if price missing: rejected — couples invoice creation to price configuration completeness; creates operational friction.
Use latest active price regardless of effective_from: rejected — removes the time-aware pricing capability.
Store price as a FK reference on invoice_line: rejected — FK to price master row allows retroactive price edits to silently change historical invoices.

new_decisions.decision: Invoices are created on-demand by SUPERVISOR via POST /invoices {sales_header_id} — NOT auto-triggered during sales saves. One invoice per sales transaction enforced by UNIQUE(sales_header_id) on tbl_invoice_header.
new_decisions.rationale: Auto-triggering invoice creation on every POST /sales would require prices to be configured for all (design, grade) pairs before any sale can be saved — blocking the data-entry flow that was operational in V1. On-demand creation gives the supervisor control over the invoicing timeline and accommodates the common scenario where prices are configured after sales are entered. The UNIQUE constraint prevents double-invoicing. invoice_number is deterministic (INV-{date}-{sales_header_id}) so accidental duplicate creation attempts get a clear 409.
new_decisions.tradeoffs: Invoices must be created manually per sale — a supervisor could forget to invoice some transactions. Mitigation: GET /invoices can filter by uninvoiced sales (LEFT JOIN on sales_header_id IS NULL) — implementable in V3 as a convenience endpoint.
alternatives_considered: Auto-create invoice in sales save transaction: rejected — blocks sales entry when prices are missing; tight coupling between M-002 (transactions) and M-011 (invoicing).
Batch invoice creation (invoice all un-invoiced sales): considered for V3 — useful but out of V2 scope.
